decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting draws directly on the firm's deep know-how in robust, certified specialist lighting, so it can interpret feedback from defence customers and keep improving this long-cycle product line.
As a second-generation core interior luminaire, it builds on existing LED and testing knowledge and sits at the heart of the established business, so it is easily absorbed and refined.
The microprismatic pendant is a flagship grounded in the firm's own optics research and its focus on glare-free, efficient lighting, so management keeps investing in and learning from it.

The marine HMI searchlight uses the firm's marine expertise, but HMI is a legacy light source that runs against the LED direction, so it stays for now with a rising risk of replacement by an LED successor.
